generator.negativePromptHandling: negative constraints are inlined into the prompt as an 'Avoid: ...' clause and also stored per task in negativePrompt for reproducibility with other tools
generator.note: The tool interface exposes no verified model name or terms URL, so both are recorded as pending-review rather than asserted.

sharedNegativePrompt: text, watermark, logo, brand mark, signature, letters, caption, extra faces, duplicated features, distorted face, asymmetrical eyes, deformed hands, extra limbs, missing limbs, cropped feet, extreme wide-angle distortion, plastic skin, heavy makeup, jewellery, busy background, cluttered scene

cornerMarkPolicy.issue: The generator stamps an 'AI生成 / WORKBUDDY' mark in the bottom-right corner of every image. The tool exposes no way to disable it (footnote="" has no effect).
cornerMarkPolicy.action: Uniform top-left-anchored crop removes the corner region. No scaling or stretching is applied. Source PNGs are kept in work/raw/ and are not distributed.
cornerMarkPolicy.rationale: The 'WORKBUDDY' wordmark is a third-party brand mark that the asset specification forbids; AI provenance is disclosed in full in PROVENANCE.md, ASSET_LICENSE.md and README.md.

retryPolicy.onFailure: mark rejected and report the gap; do not retry indefinitely
